=You are reading one email newsletter. Pull out the main stories so a busy person can skim them.

Newsletter: {{ $json.from }}
Subject: {{ $json.subject }}

--- NEWSLETTER START ---
{{ $json.content }}
--- NEWSLETTER END ---

Rules:
- Skip ads, sponsored sections, promotions, job listings, event invites, and footer text.
- Maximum 8 stories. Pick the most important ones.
- Only use links that appear in the newsletter text. Never make up a link. If a story has no link, write "Link: none".
- Write in plain, simple English.

Reply in exactly this format:

Source: {{ $json.from }}

- Headline: one or two sentences on what happened and why it matters.
  Link: https://...

- Headline: one or two sentences on what happened and why it matters.
  Link: https://...

If there are no real stories (only ads or account notices), reply with exactly: NO STORIES

=You are writing a daily email digest for a busy small-business owner. Below are summaries of today's newsletters.

Today's date: {{ $now.toFormat('cccc, d LLLL yyyy') }}

--- SUMMARIES START ---
{{ $json.text.filter(t => !t.includes('NO STORIES')).join('\n\n=====\n\n') }}
--- SUMMARIES END ---

Your job:
1. Write a short overview (3 to 4 sentences) of the most important things today.
2. If two or more newsletters cover the same story, merge them into ONE story.
3. Group the stories under 2 to 5 clear topic headings (for example: AI Tools, Business, Product Updates). Put the most important topic first.
4. For each story: a bold headline, 1 to 2 sentences in plain English, and a "Read more" link.
5. Use the links exactly as given. Never make up or change a link. If a story says "Link: none", leave out the Read more link.
6. Mention which newsletter each story came from, in small grey text.

Write the email in simple HTML using only these tags: h1, h2, p, strong, a, br, hr, div, span. Use inline styles only: font-family Arial, max width 640px, dark grey text, blue links, light grey box behind the overview.

Start with an h1 that says: Your Newsletter Digest
Under it, a small grey line with today's date.

Reply with ONLY the HTML. No explanations. Do not wrap it in ``` code blocks.
